reason: User asks to prioritize MSE. Original capacity-first CSR candidates worsened mean fresh learning-chart MSE by about 19-25%.
frozen_dense_models: Keep retraining/results/h40,h60,h100/model_parameters.h unchanged. No retraining in this step.
selection_inputs: Previously measured separate validation chart (two reads)
Predefined unlabeled Cartesian grid: 0,0.125,...,1 in each input channel (729 inputs)

selection_constraints.csr_model_bytes: strictly smaller than original Dense arrays
selection_constraints.learning_all33_rgb8_mse: no more than original Dense MSE times 1.05
selection_constraints.validation_each_read_rgb8_mse: no more than original Dense MSE of that read times 1.05
selection_constraints.uniform_grid_clipped_output_max_abs_diff: no more than 0.5/255 from Dense, before RGB8 rounding

candidate_rule: Existing midpoints between distinct absolute frozen weights, common to three layers, biases unchanged; not five preset thresholds.
objective: Smallest CSR array bytes satisfying all constraints. Inspect candidates in ascending storage size; stop at first passing candidate. Error need not be monotonic.
fresh_readings_capture_1_and_3: Already observed before this method change; not used for candidate filtering or ranking. Replay after candidate freeze is a post-hoc diagnostic, not independent confirmation.
scope: Try to preserve Dense predictions while reducing storage. This does not address high absolute Dense MSE from physical re-reading and does not guarantee improvement on every possible input.
confirmation: A newly acquired chart read after freezing the follow-up candidate is needed to check repeat-read accuracy; same learning-chart colors still do not form independent final chart evaluation.
original_results: Preserve all original candidates, hardware logs and result tables; record this as a separate exploratory method.
